newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Leading Spirit says considers spinoff.
newsitem.headline: Leading Spirit says considers spinoff.

text.p: Leading Spirit (Holdings) Co Ltd said on Monday it was considering a spinoff of its home electrical appliance division.
"The company is seriously considering the proposal," the company said in a statement issued through the Hong Kong stock exchange. It said no application has yet been made to the Stock Exchange.
"Investors should exercise caution in dealing with securities of the company," it added.
Local press reported on Monday that Leading Spirit was planning to sell 25 percent of the its electrical appliance division at HK$1.00 per share, raising about HK$500 million.
Leading Spirit planned to make an application to the stock exchnage by the end of January and launch the shares' debut in March, the report said.
Shares of Leading Spirit rose HK$0.03 to HK$1.42 per share in late trade.
